config_notes: Retries set to 0 (default 2); timeout set to 3 seconds.
Model surfaces use messages().createStreaming with MessageAccumulator.message(), or messages().create().
Loop surfaces use beta().messages().toolRunner(ToolRunnerCreateParams), iterated directly or through streaming(); tools use BetaRunnableTool.of(Class, Function).
ToolRunnerCreateParams.thread(false) sends the whole conversation on the ordinary messages endpoint; the released default enables server-side message threads.
Every message yielded by BetaToolRunner is visible to its caller and is retained in caller observations.
Non-beta model parameters use explicit Tool and Tool.InputSchema builders; the Class overload is available on beta message parameters.

flush_notes uses an explicit empty BetaTool schema with BetaRunnableTool.of(BetaTool, Function); the SDK class-schema generator rejects empty classes before any request. Parameterized recorder tools retain typed SDK binding.
